title: Nike shares plummet 10% after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway - CNBC
description: Nike's shares plummeted in premarket trading, continuing a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise ahead of key jobs report as oil steadies - Yahoo Finance
description: The Labor Department's September jobs report, oil prices, and bond yields were the key things to watch on Friday in markets.

title: Patient dies by suicide after "insurance issue" delayed medicine for lung disease flare-ups - CBS News
description: Hours after experiencing a flare-up related to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, Kenney Blewett of Kyle, Texas, died by suicide in June.

title: Trump is bringing big projects to red states. Republicans fear they’re too late. - Politico
description: The projects — which include a $50 billion natural gas pipeline in Alaska and a $15 billion steel plant in Iowa — are earning bipartisan plaudits, but still may not move the electoral needle.

title: Christa Pike is in critical condition after failed execution in Tennessee, her lawyers say - NBC News
description: At least seven needles were used to administer the lethal injection doses into Pike’s arm over the course of an hour, said one of her lawyers, who witnessed the botched execution attempt.
